cohort: The study included 430 women who had a successful external cephalic version (ECV) compared to women with spontaneous cephalic presentation.
finding: Women who had a successful ECV had an increased risk of intrapartum cesarean section compared to those with spontaneous cephalic presentation, even after adjusting for other factors.
mod_finding: Women who had a successful ECV had an increased risk of intrapartum cesarean section (OR = 1.5) compared to women with spontaneous cephalic presentation.
